query: I heard you ran the Microsoft Azure Marketplace partner program refresh. What pipeline lift did that drive?

props.title: Measuring Pipeline Lift from a Partner Program Refresh
props.subtitle: Partner marketing performance
props.challengeSummary: You're asking about the pipeline impact of a marketplace partner program refresh and what it delivered.

props.title: Research Before Redesign
props.content: For a partner program, we begin with evidence on how partners use it today, then build the improvement roadmap from that. A refresh built on actual partner behavior has a better chance of earning adoption than one built on assumptions.

props.title: Salesforce: Supporting the largest partner ecosystem in the tech industry
props.summary: We researched how partner marketers use Salesforce's PMC and created a roadmap for improvements to drive adoption and satisfaction. We continue to work with Salesforce on revamping it.

props.title: Salesforce/Slack: Strategic Sales Enablement
props.summary: We created a suite of downloadable content to help Salesforce's global partners market their Slack implementation services: a playbook, an email drip campaign, a call script and social media copy.

final.explanation: We can't point to a Microsoft Azure Marketplace engagement in our portfolio, so we can't speak to a pipeline lift for it. The Salesforce work above is adjacent, since it also serves partners, and neither study states a pipeline figure. If you're planning a refresh of your own, we'd start by agreeing which pipeline signals matter for your program, so the work is built around them. Our Strategy Lead can scope that with you.
